     assert len(after_tasks) == 2
     assert after_tasks[0]["title"] == "Task Alpha"
     assert after_tasks[1]["title"] == "Task Beta"
+
+
+def test_health_endpoint_rejected_methods(client_with_db):
+    # Ensure tasks table has data to check for side effects
+    client_with_db.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Side Effect Check Task"})
+    initial_tasks = client_with_db.get("/tasks").json()
+
+    for method in ["post", "put", "delete", "patch"]:
+        fn = getattr(client_with_db, method)
+        response = fn("/healthz")
+        assert response.status_code == 405
+
+    # Verify task data remains completely unmodified after rejected methods
+    after_tasks = client_with_db.get("/tasks").json()
+    assert after_tasks == initial_tasks
+    assert len(after_tasks) == 1
+    assert after_tasks[0]["title"] == "Side Effect Check Task"
